title: Early Childhood Educator
short: Plan and deliver early childhood curriculum for children aged 3–5.
details: We are looking for a nurturing Lead Teacher with minimum 2 years experience in early childhood education. Responsibilities include lesson planning, parent communication and child assessment.

title: Childcare Assistant
short: Support Lead Teachers with daily care routines and classroom activities.
details: Assist with supervision, meal times and play-based learning. Good communication and a caring manner required. Early childhood coursework or equivalent experience preferred.

title: Cleaner
short: Help keep our daycare clean, safe, and welcoming on weekdays.
details: We are hiring a part-time Cleaner for weekday shifts. Responsibilities include cleaning classrooms, washrooms, common areas, and helping maintain a safe, sanitary environment for children and staff. Reliability, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic are required.

title: Cleaner
short: Help keep our daycare clean, safe, and welcoming in a full-time role.
details: We are hiring a full-time Cleaner to help maintain a clean, safe, and sanitary environment for children and staff. Responsibilities include cleaning classrooms, washrooms, and common areas, as well as supporting daily upkeep throughout the centre. Reliability, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic are required.
